protocol.attribution_rule: best checkpoint inference interventions; not retrained order ablations; include TOHI-A-RN reference
protocol.best_epoch_rule: minimum validation ADE, earliest epoch on exact tie; report paired FDE of that epoch
protocol.convergence_rule: relative train loss decrease in final five epochs < 2%; diagnostic only, not proof of optimum
protocol.first_round_pause_rule: all social models best ADE > 1.05*PedBase best ADE and no FDE improvement
protocol.group_rule: cutoff-visible people; average incoming degree over eligible contiguous observation steps: 0,(0,1],(1,3],>3; order support at cutoff
protocol.metrics: K1 ADE/FDE meters; fixed final-horizon FDE mask
protocol.selection_rule: lowest best-ADE social; add lowest TOHI if different and within 5% of best social, else second social
protocol.shuffle_rule: resample same incoming count within same radius-valid candidate set, no self/cross-scene, fixed seed17025
